many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

steps.input:
def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    row=[r for r in inp if any(x!=0 for x in r)][-1]  # anchor: 2 3 5 1 6 4
    seq=[c for c in row if c!=0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=0 and (i,j) not in [(H-1,k) for k in range(len(seq))]]
    for i,j in cells:
        # find seq value = inp[i][j] within seq, index s
        si=seq.index(inp[i][j])
        left=j-si; right=s+len(seq)-1-i*1
        for t,c in zip(range(-left,s), [inp[i][j]]*(t==0)): pass
        # paint full seq on row i at columns j-left..right
        for k,dd in enumerate(range(j-si-1+1, j+(len(seq)-si))):
            out[i][dd]=seq[(si+k)%len(seq)]
    return out
d=G['Demo pair 1 input']
o=solve(d)
print(o==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
for r in o: print(r)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    # runs: contiguous >=2 nonzero digits in a row
    runs=[]
    for i,r_ in enumerate(gi):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if r_[j]:
                k=j
                while k+1<W and r_[k+1]==r_[k] and r_[k+1]: k+=1
                if k-j>=1: runs.append((i,j,k,r_[j]))
                j=k+1
            else: j+=1
    # strays: rows with exactly one nonzero
    for i,r_ in enumerate(gi):
        nz=[j for j in range(W) if r_[j]]
        if len(nz)!=1: continue
        j=nz[0]; v=r_[j]
        cands=[(abs(j-c),s,c) for (si,c,e_,val) in runs for s in [val] if v in s and s.index(v)>=0]
        # proper: run value multiset contains v
        cands=[(abs(j-c),s,c) for (si,c,e_,val) in runs if val in [v] and v in s]
        cands.sort()
        _,seq,ca=cands[0]
        n=len(seq); idx=seq.index(v)
        if idx==0: L,R=j,j+n-1
        elif idx==n-1: L,R=j-(n-1),j
        else: L,R=j-(n-1-idx)-1,j+(n-1-idx)
        L=max(0,L); R=min(W-1,R)
        for c in range(L,R+1):
            g[i][c]=seq[(c-j+idx)%n]
    return g

ok=True
for p in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    r=f(gi)
    match = r==go
    ok &= match
    print('pair',p,'match' if match else 'MISMATCH')
    if not match:
        for a,b in zip(r,go): print(''.join(map(str,a)),'|',''.join(map(str,b)))
print('ALL' if ok else 'FAIL')
ti=G['Test input']
res=f(ti)
for r_ in res: print(''.join(map(str,r_)))

def f(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0]); out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    seqs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=gi[r]
        cells=[c for c in range(w) if row[c]!=0]
        if len(cells)>=2:
            sp=[]
            for cl in cells:
                if sp and cl!=sp[-1]+1: break
                sp.append(cl)
            if len(sp)>1: seqs.append((r,row[sp[0]:sp[-1]+1]))
    # assign each stray to nearest seq (min |dr|, then min dc)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=gi[r][c]
            if v==0 or (r,c) in [(a,b) for a,s in seqs for b in range(w) if s and True]: continue
            if any(v in s for _,s in seqs):
                best=min(((abs(r-a), abs(c-b), a, b, s, s.index(v)) for a,s in seqs if v in s for b in range(len(s)) if False) , key=lambda t:t[:2])
                # simpler: min over seqs of (|dr|, |dc|) where dr=r-seqrow, dc=c-any cell of seq span
                cands=[(abs(r-a), min(abs(c-b) for b in range(a0,a0+len(s))) , a, s, s.index(v)) for a,s in seqs if v in s for a0 in [0]]
                best=min(cands,key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1]))
                a,s,k=best[2],best[3],best[4]
                n=len(s)
                lo=max(0,c-k); hi=min(w-1,c+n-1-k)
                for cc in range(lo,hi+1):
                    if out[r][cc]==0: out[r][cc]=s[(k+cc-c)%n]
    return out

import json
def f(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0]); out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    seqs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=gi[r]
        cells=[c for c in range(w) if row[c]!=0]
        if len(cells)>=2:
            sp=[]
            for cl in cells:
                if sp and cl!=sp[-1]+1: break
                sp.append(cl)
            if len(sp)>1: seqs.append((r,row[sp[0]:sp[-1]+1]))
    used=set()
    for a,s in seqs: used.update(((a,b) for b in range(a,a+len(s))))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=gi[r][c]
            if v==0 or (r,c) in used: continue
            # skip if stray value not in any sequence value set
            found=False
            best=None
            for idx,(sr,s) in enumerate(seqs):
                if v not in s: continue
                k=s.index(v)
                d_row=abs(r-sr)
                cols=[b for b in range(sr,sr+len(s))]
                d_col=min(abs(c-b) for b in cols)
                cand=(d_row+d_col, d_row, d_col, sr, s, k)
                if best is None or cand<best: best=cand
            if best is None: continue
            _,_,_,sr,s,k=best
            n=len(s)
            lo=max(0,c-k); hi=min(w-1,c+n-1-k)
            for cc in range(lo,hi+1):
                if out[r][cc]==0: out[r][cc]=s[(k+(cc-c))%n]
    return out
for pn in (1,2,3):
    print(pn, f(G[f'Demo pair {pn} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {pn} output'])
print('ALL', all(f(G[f'Demo pair {pn} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {pn} output'] for pn in (1,2,3)))
pred=f(G['Test input'])
for rr in pred: print(''.join(map(str,rr)))
print(json.dumps(pred))

def runs_of(g):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0]);out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        c=0
        while c<w:
            if g[r][c]:
                j=c
                while j<w and g[r][j]: j+=1
                out.append((r,c,j,g[r][c:j]))
                c=j
            else: c+=1
    return out
G=load()
# gather stray->assignment data across demos: for each stray (color v at (r,c)) find chosen (seq, idx) from output
for pn in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {pn} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {pn} output']
    rs=runs_of(gi)
    occ={}
    for r,c,j,s in rs:
        for b in range(len(s)): occ.setdefault(s[b],[]).append((r,c,b,s))
    for r in range(len(gi)):
        for c in range(len(gi[0])):
            v=gi[r][c]
            if v==0: continue
            # is this cell part of a run in input?
            inrun=False
            for rr,cc,j,s in rs:
                if rr==r and cc<=c<j: inrun=True
            if inrun: continue
            # find where v appears in output row r: output cells equal v near c
            oc=[x for x in range(len(go[r])) if go[r][x]==v]
            # nearest run containing v
            cands=[t for t in occ.get(v,[]) if abs(t[0]-r)+abs(t[1]-c)<6]
            if not cands: continue
            best=min(cands,key=lambda t:abs(t[0]-r)+abs(t[1]-c))
            _,sc,b,s=bet:=None
            best=min(cands,key=lambda t:abs(t[0]-r)+abs(t[1]-c))
            _,sc,b,s=best
            # predicted painted cells: s[(k+cc-c)%n] etc.; determine actual painted extent in output row
            left=[x for x in range(len(go[r])) if go[r][x]!=0 and (x<c or x>c) and (go[r][x]==s[( (b-x+c)%len(s) )] if False else go[r][x]==s[((c+b-x)%len(s))])]
            # simpler: infer idx from where s value matches output: painted cells are those != input and in [sc-?,...]
            # find contiguous painted block containing/adjacent: painted = cells x where go[r][x]==s[(x-sc+b)%n] and go!=gi
            painted=[x for x in range(len(go[r])) if go[r][x]!=gi[r][x]]
            # hypothesis: painted block = [c-k .. c+n-1-k]; find k such that go[r][x]==s[(x-k+b+n)%n] for painted x
            sols=[]
            for k in range(-len(s),len(s)+1):
                if all(go[r][x]==s[((x-k+b)%len(s))] for x in painted if 0<=x<len(go[r])):
                    # consistency over a wider range too
                    ok=all(0<=x<len(go[r]) and go[r][x]==s[((x-k+b)%len(s))] for x in range(max(0,c-4),min(len(go[r]),c+len(s)+4)))
                    if ok: sols.append(k)
            print(pn,'stray',(r,c),'v=',v,'seq=',s,'b=',b,'k_sols=',sols,'c=',c)

G=load()
def runs(g):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0]);res=[]
    for r in range(h):
        c=0
        while c<w:
            if g[r][c]:
                j=c
                while j<w and g[r][j]: j+=1
                if j-c>=2: res.append((r,c,j,g[r][c:j]))
                c=j
            else: c+=1
    return res
for pn in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {pn} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {pn} output']

    for r in range(len(gi)):
        for c in range(len(gi[0])):
            v=gi[r][c]

            inrun=any(rr==r and cc<=c<j for rr,cc,j,_ in rs)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    singles=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if cnt[g[r][c]]==1]
    ink=singles[0][2] if singles else None
    for ir,ic,v in singles: res[ir][ic]=4
    for r in (0,H-1):
        c=0; run=[]
        while c<W and g[r][c]!=bg: run.append(c); c+=1
        if len(run)>=2:
            src=run[-1] if r==0 else run[0]; step=1 if r==0 else -1
            for rr in range(src+step, H-step if r==0 else -1, step):
                if not(0<=rr<H) or g[rr][src]==4: continue
                if g[rr][src]!=bg: break
                res[rr][src]=ink
    return res

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    singles=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if cnt[g[r][c]]==1]
    for ir,ic,v in singles: res[ir][ic]=4
    # beam per singleton: from singleton toward nearest non-bg cell in its column (up or down)
    for ir,ic,v in singles:
        up=[k for k in range(ir+1,H) if g[k][ic]!=bg]
        dn=[k for k in range(ir-1,-1,-1) if g[k][ic]!=bg]
        if not up and not dn: continue
        tgt=dn[0] if (dn and dn[0]<0) else None
        cand=[]
        if up: cand.append(('down',min(up)))
        if dn: cand.append(('up',min(dn)))
        srt,cand_=min(cand,key=lambda x: x[1]-ir if x[0]=='down' else ir-x[1])
        cells=list(range(srt, ir+1)) if srt=='up' else list(range(ir+1, cand_))
        for k in cells:
            if g[k][ic]==4: break
            res[k][ic]=v
            if g[k][ic]!=bg: break

def solve(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    go=[row[:] for row in gi]
    # find seq rows: rows that are horizontal runs of consecutive nonzero colors (length>=2)
    seqs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=gi[r]; segs=[]
        c=0
        while c<w:
            if row[c]!=0:
                s=row[c]; k=c
                while k<w and row[k]==s: k+=1
                if k-c>=2: segs.append((s,k-c,c))  # value,len,startcol
                c=k
            else: c+=1
        if segs: seqs.append(segs)
    for r in range(h):
        row=go[r]; c=0
        while c<w:
            if row[c]!=0 and c+1<w and row[c+1]!=0 and row[c]!=row[c+1]:
                s=row[c]; k=c
                while k<w and row[k]==s: k+=1
                if k-c>=2: segs.append((s,k-c,c)); c=k; continue
            c+=1
        if segs: continue
        # row is a seq row: anchors only
        continue
    # process anchor rows: for each nonzero cell in a non-seq row
    for r in range(h):
        row=gi[r]
        if any(row[c]!=0 for c in range(w)) and not any(row[c]!=0 and c+1<w and row[c]!=row[c+1] for c in range(w-1)):
            pass
        # simpler: seq row if contains a run of len>=2
        has_run=any(c+1<w and row[c]!=0 and row[c+1]!=0 for c in range(w-1))
        if has_run: continue
        for c in range(w):
            if row[c]==0: continue
            v=row[c]
            # find seq containing v
            cand=[(si,s) for si,segs in enumerate(seqs) for s,_,_ in segs if s==v]
            if not cand: continue
            si,s,cn=cand[0]
            left=cn          # cells from anchor leftward = cn (anchor + cn-1 cells to its left)
            right=segs[si][1]-cn
            if right>left:
                step=1
                # paint rightward: anchor cell keeps v; cells to the right get seq values
                for k in range(1,right+1):
                    go[r][c+k]=segs[si][(cn+k)%segs[si][1]]
            else:
                for k in range(1,left+1):
                    go[r][c-k]=segs[si][cn-k] if cn-k>=0 else segs[si][segs[si][1]-((cn-k)%segs[si][1])]
    return go
for i in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    pred=solve(gi)
    print(i, pred==go)

def f(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    g=[row[:] for row in gi]
    # sequence S from bottom row blocks, and bar index per color
    last=g[-1]; blk=blocks_of(last)
    seq=[]; pos={}
    for s,l,st in blk:
        seq+=last[st:st+l]
        for c in range(st,st+l): pos[last[c]]=c
    # singles: non-bottom cells not part of multi-block
    used=set(range(w))|set() 
    for r in range(h-2,-1,-1):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=0:
                v=g[r][c]
                # is it part of a horizontal run? (check same row neighbors)
                run=run_at(g,r,c,v)
                if len(run)>1 or r==h-1: continue
                p=pos[v]
                start=c-lv
                end=c+lv
                fill_row(seq,p,c,len(run),g,h,w)
    return g
def run_at(grid,r,c,v):
    w=len(grid[0]); L=0
    c0=c
    while c0>0 and grid[r][c0-1]==v: c0-=1; L+=1
    c1=c0
    while c1<w-1 and grid[r][c1+1]==v: c1+=1
    return L,(c0,c1)
def fill_row(seq,p,start,L,g,h,w):
    n=len(seq); col=start-p
    if col>=n or col<0: return
    L=L//2  # half-length each direction
    # leftward: extend up to col 0... but demos fill only limited distances. Use demo evidence: paint until edge but stop at... check pair2 row8: anchor 4 at p3? seq 1,2,4,3 pos4@2; painted cols0..9 = seq with anchor 4 at col6. So length fills to edge.
    L=min(L, min(start, w-1-start)+1)  # cap by distance to nearest edge? test below
    # simpler: paint full run from col-start-L to col+L where L = min(distance, n)//? just do:
    left=min(col,max(0,col-n)); right=min(w-1,col+n)
    for i in range(left,right+1):
        g[r][(i-col+p)%w]=seq[(i-col+p)%n]
    return
